title: PRD-05 synthetic risk input syntax

coverageMode.description: required; standalone or rider; offered mode only. Sensitivity: internal. Error: EARTHQUAKE_MODE_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

basePolicyOrQuoteRef.description: required for rider; same permitted property and interest. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: BASE_COVER_INCOMPATIBLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

locationRef.description: required; risk-zone mapping version retained. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: LOCATION_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

constructionCode.description: required; contract-mapped structural category. Sensitivity: internal. Error: STRUCTURE_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

insuredValue.description: required; positive; valuation basis explicit. Sensitivity: financial. Error: VALUE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

limitOption.description: required; offered limit code <= 40. Sensitivity: internal. Error: LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

deductibleOption.description: required; offered deductible code <= 40. Sensitivity: internal. Error: DEDUCTIBLE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
